title: Collections Desk Reference — Late Charge, Suspension and Invoice Terms (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
For the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, the figures below govern late charges on overdue remittances, suspension of a program for remittances past due, reinstatement, and the issue and payment terms of program invoices.

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days after a remittance due date before a late charge can be assessed | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Late charge rate on the overdue remittance for each late-charge period (percent) | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.25 | 1.25 | 1.0 |
| Minimum late charge per late-charge period (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 50.00 | 75.00 | 100.00 |
| Length of one late-charge period counted from the due date (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Late charges that may be waived as a courtesy in any rolling 365 days | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| Calendar days a remittance may stay past due before the program is suspended | 15 | 15 | 20 | 20 | 30 | 30 |
| Suspended program reinstated only once every past-due remittance and charge is paid | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Calendar days after the invoice date by which an invoice must be paid | 15 | 15 | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 |
| Business day of the following month on which a month's invoice is issued | 3rd | 3rd | 3rd | 3rd | 3rd | 3rd |

## Notes on the figures

- The grace is counted in business days (Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays); the late-charge period and the suspension count are calendar days.
- A tier showing 0 courtesy waivers grants none; the Strategic tier allows two in any rolling 365 days.
- On every tier full cure is required for reinstatement: every past-due remittance and charge must be paid.
